$comment: The booking page — the site's main conversion path. Channels point at clinic.contact through `field` (phone, whatsapp, email, address, emergency), so a number is written once in clinic.json and every button follows it. An explicit `href` or `value` on a channel overrides the derived one.

hero.title: Talk to a dentist, not a form.
hero.intro: There is no booking form here on purpose. Call or message the clinic and a real person confirms your slot in under a minute — with the dentist you actually need.

primaryChannels.message: Hello, I'd like to book an appointment.
primaryChannels.label: WhatsApp
primaryChannels.note: Send your preferred day and time

emergency.title: Dental emergency?
emergency.text: Severe pain, swelling, a knocked-out tooth or bleeding that will not stop. Call the emergency line at any hour, including Sundays.

whatToSay.title: What to mention when you call.
items: The problem in your own words, or 'routine check-up' if there is none
Whether you are in pain right now, and for how long
Days and times that suit you, including any you cannot do
Whether you have visited us before, and under which name

note: This page connects you directly to the clinic. No details are stored on this website and nothing is submitted anywhere.
